_comment: STAGE 2 OF 5 of the security study (#358) — the soft circuit breaker. REAL MONEY. Four limits so small that one min-lot fill's fee crosses all of them: the block engages on the real account value and names every limit that fired. The account must hold none of the base at the start (`start_flat`) — a held base moves the account value with every tick and would trip these limits at a moment nobody chose. A fresh baseline (persist_baseline false), so an earlier attempt's record never decides this one.

deployment._comment: A stage of the security study, never a deployment: each session is its own one-off.

phase_sequence._comment: The breaker values the account on each tick; ten seconds of ticks see the fill's cost.
Closing is never blocked — only new entries are.
